test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

L _ _ L _ M _ L _ _ M _
solution:
Given series: L _ _ L _ M _ L _ _ M _

Option 1) MLMLMLL → L __M__ __L__ L __M__ M __L__ L __M__ __L__ M __L__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) MMLMLML → L __**M**__ __**M**__ L __**L**__ M __**M**__ L __**L**__ __**M**__ M __**L**__ → (It follows the pattern of: LMML - LMML - LMML)

Option 3) LLMMLMM → L __L__ __L__ L __M__ M __M__ L __L__ __M__ M __M__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) LMLMLMM → L __L__ __M__ L __L__ M __M__ L __L__ __M__ M __M__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
